title: nan
authors: Lam M.; Herrera J.; Afzal S.S.; Zhou K.; Adib F.
key_contribution: Presents MiNav, a system for autonomous drone navigation in featureless/dark indoor environments using millimeter-wave radar and backscatter tags, achieving median 3D error of 9.1 cm across 165 missions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
